narration:0:1460123001:1.text: To see all preparations completed in haste, you politely, though with some regret, decline the invitation from Sinbad and Bols to drink through the night.
narration:0:1460123001:1.source_cn: 为了尽早达成邀请，你们不得不忍痛拒绝了辛巴达和波尔斯的...

narration:2:1460123002:0.text: With haste, you depart for Cedartown and proceed directly to the Radinov Manor...
narration:2:1460123002:0.source_cn: 动身前往雪松镇，直奔拉季诺夫庄园的遗址……

say:3:1460123003:0.text: By chance, as you arrive, you find Carolina and Callan already entertaining familiar faces...
say:3:1460123003:0.source_cn: 很巧的是，卡列琳娜和铐兰也正在招待着客人们……

say:5:1460123004:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! It's good to see you again, but why are you here? Oh, and we have another guest!
say:5:1460123004:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! It's good to see you again, but why are you here? Oh, and we have another guest!
say:5:1460123004:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! It's good to see you again, but why are you here? Oh, and we have another guest!

say:6:1460123005:0.text: It just so happens that Lady Valka and Viscount Ludovic are here as well. Why don't you all sit down and have a cup of tea with us?
say:6:1460123005:0.source_cn: 正好，瓦丽卡和子爵先生也在，大家坐下来喝一杯下午茶吧？

say:7:1460123006:0.text: In the comfort of Carolina's hospitality, you partake in the exquisite flower tea and delicacies presented by Viscount Ludovic, then proceed to disclose the reason for your visit...
say:7:1460123006:0.source_cn: 在卡列琳娜的招待下，你们享用了柳博米尔带来的美味花茶和...

say:12:1460123007:0.text: Truth be told, we were but breaking bread and sharing tea, pondering our course henceforth until thy sudden arrival.
say:12:1460123007:0.source_cn: 不瞒你们，我们在这里聚餐喝茶，也是在考虑接下来的行动—...

say:13:1460123008:1.text: As <style="stress"><player_name></style> said, this presents a grand opportunity for us Graveborn to reveal ourselves unto the world.
say:13:1460123008:1.male: As <style="stress"><player_name></style> said, this presents a grand opportunity for us Graveborn to reveal ourselves unto the world.
say:13:1460123008:1.female: As <style="stress"><player_name></style> said, this presents a grand opportunity for us Graveborn to reveal ourselves unto the world.

say:14:1460123009:1.text: Yes, it would also be most beneficial if qualifying matches could be set up here.
say:14:1460123009:1.source_cn: 嗯，尤其是预选赛制度，如果能在这里设立一处预选赛的比赛...

say:15:1460123010:1.text: And here I thought Lord Ludovic hated noisy battles.
say:15:1460123010:1.source_cn: 咦？我还以为柳博米尔先生你不喜欢吵吵闹闹的战斗。

say:16:1460123011:1.text: No, you're right. I hate them. That's why I would like Carolina to organize the qualifiers and screen the participants.
say:16:1460123011:1.source_cn: 我确实不喜欢。所以，我想建议的是，由卡列琳娜负责组织预...

say:17:1460123012:1.text: Valka can participate in the tournament, so someone needs to stay here to keep things in line.
say:17:1460123012:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡应该会去参赛，那么这里总需要留人驻守的。

say:21:1460123014:1.text: Indeed, I remember you saying you wish to reshape the legacy that Whiteridge has long held of the Graveborn.
say:21:1460123014:1.source_cn: 嗯，我记得你说过，想要改变白山对于亡灵流传千百年的认知。

say:22:1460123015:1.text: I think personally organizing, promoting, and taking charge of the qualifying matches for the main tournament will further advance your aspirations.
say:22:1460123015:1.source_cn: 而亲自组织、宣传并负责一场大赛的预选赛，我想，更能推进...

say:23:1460123016:1.text: Carolina is much like yourself, Lord Ludovic. She finds solace in silence and shuns the clamor of company. Best to let the matter rest.
say:23:1460123016:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜和你一样，喜欢安静，也不爱和人打交道，还是算了。

say:24:1460123017:1.text: If need be, I shall assume responsibility.

say:25:1460123018:1.text: No, Valka, thank you for thinking of me, but I want to give this a try.
say:25:1460123018:1.source_cn: 不，瓦丽卡姐姐，我明白你的好意，但我想来试试。

say:26:1460123019:1.text: Like I just said, let's team up and compete with <style="stress"><player_name></style> first.
say:26:1460123019:1.source_cn: 就像刚刚说的那样，先由我们联手与<style=stre...
say:26:1460123019:1.male: Like I just said, let's team up and compete with <style="stress"><player_name></style> first.
say:26:1460123019:1.female: Like I just said, let's team up and compete with <style="stress"><player_name></style> first.

say:27:1460123020:0.text: Let Master Pang evaluate if I'm qualified to host the screening of the fighters.
say:27:1460123020:0.source_cn: 让这位潘先生点评一下，我是否有相应的资格，来主持这场筛选。

say:33:1460123022:0.text: No, Callan, this is a tournament. I need to do this myself.
say:33:1460123022:0.source_cn: 不，哥哥，这是参赛者的切磋，所以，我需要亲自站出去。

say:39:1460123024:1.text: Okay, if I get the qualification to host the preliminaries, my brother can be the defender in the first few rounds.
say:39:1460123024:1.source_cn: 那么，等我拿到主持预选赛的资格后，就由哥哥来担任一环的...

say:40:1460123025:1.text: With Carolina's gentle yet unwavering insistence, Callan ultimately consents to her request.
say:40:1460123025:1.source_cn: 在卡列琳娜温和而坚定的劝说下，铐兰终于同意了要求。

say:43:1460123026:1.text: Wait! I have a most worthy comrade for this contest.
say:43:1460123026:1.source_cn: 等等！我这里还有一位非常适合参赛的伙伴——

say:44:1460123027:1.text: I can invite Igor and we'll take up arms together.
say:44:1460123027:1.source_cn: 我去把伊戈尔喊来，一起作战！
